purpose: PDF-inspired end-to-end finite research search, not completion of live-trading phases or proof of alpha.

market_density.method: Nonnegative discrete probabilities fitted to bid/ask option price intervals; total mass 1 and mean equals parity forward. L1 quote-interval violations minimized with weak L1 distance to ATM lognormal prior.
market_density.support: 5-point observed strikes around F within 4 sigma plus ATM-lognormal quantiles 0.000001 and 0.999999; finite tail is an explicit approximation

state_model.method: Equal mixture of unconditional historical-residual KDE and a 1.5-bandwidth Gaussian-feature-weighted KDE; no fitted regression or ML.

model_selection.score: trailing standardized CRPS on forecasts made with earlier-only training, matched by entry time and expiry offset
model_selection.primary_gate: Choose lowest prior CRPS P model; require its paired mean CRPS strictly below the fitted market density. Never use current/future outcomes or historical strategy PnL for model choice.

execution.price: buy ask, sell bid; required execution-side displayed size; not guaranteed simultaneous execution
execution.selection: At each scheduled time compare available expiries and structures; choose largest net EV / max loss passing filters; first qualifying time enters. No ex-post best-time selection.
execution.exit: Hold intact to cash expiry; daily SPX close proxy. No stops, profit targets, rolling, early liquidation or account leverage assumptions.

evaluation.sample_status: All existing cash outcomes have been inspected before registration. Chronological research evaluation is not an untouched holdout. No retuning after E03 outcomes.
requirements: report all skips and calendar months
mark-to-market drawdown is not available from terminal-only scoring
do not annualize or report account returns
separate fitted Q repricing residual from P-minus-Q edge
